abstract: We describe a case of an unusual adnexal lesion and concurrent collections of dendritic melanocytes of the type occurring in a blue nevus in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. To our knowledge, there have been no previous reports of benign skin adnexal tumors in an ovarian dermoid cyst. This rarity would indicate that the cutaneous adnexal tissue in a benign teratoma is not unduly prone to undergo further more-specialized secondary tumorigenesis. The combination of the three benign lesions is therefore probably purely coincidental.
abstract_ja: 稀な付属器病変と、成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に併存した青色母斑様の樹状メラノサイト集簇の症例を報告する。卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた良性皮膚付属器腫瘍の報告は、我々の知る限りない。この稀少性から、良性奇形腫の皮膚付属器組織は二次的な腫瘍発生を受けにくいことが示唆される。3つの良性病変の組み合わせは、おそらく偶発的なものである。
